title: Create - one prompt, three formats
hook: One prompt in. Platform-native drafts out.

beats.narration: A prompt or source fans out into drafts shaped for each platform you configure.
Videos build in stages you can steer: storyboard, scene direction, deterministic render.
Nothing reaches you unjudged: a denylist gate and a two-tier grounding judge run first.

cta: This demo was rendered by Thalon.
